key.name: server-url
key.description: An ntfy server that lets anyone subscribe to and send to topics that start with "up", by http or https, without a path's last "/". Every endpoint is this URL, a topic and "?up=1": another server gives every app a new endpoint, which the app passes on to its own server.

key.name: keepalive-interval
key.summary: The push server's keepalive interval, in seconds
key.description: How often the server sends a keepalive on a stream that has nothing else to send (ntfy's keepalive-interval, 45 s by default). A stream that sends nothing for twice this and 15 s is taken for dead and opened again.
